title: Online Order Fulfillment with Replenishment
summary: In modern e-commerce and service operations, firms must jointly manage inventory replenishment and real-time order fulfillment to maximize profit under demand uncertainty. While each component has been studied extensively in isolation, their interaction remains underexplored. This paper investigates a fundamental operational question: which lever plays a more decisive role in overall system performance, replenishment or fulfillment? We model the system as a one-location online order fulfillment problem with lost sales and stochastic customer arrivals, each offering heterogeneous rewards.…
